rows.lemma: oṃ [oṃ hrīṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇavāsase stute viśvasahasrahiṃsini sahasrāvane mahabaleparājite pratyaṅgire parasainyaparakarmmavidhvaṃsini paramantrotsādini sarvabhūtadamani sarvadevānbandhabandha sarvavidyāṃ chindhi chindhi kṣobhayakṣobhaya parayantrāṇi sphoṭayasphoṭaya sarvaśṛṃkhalāṃ troṭayatroṭaya jvalajvālājihve karālavadane pratyaṃgire hrīṃ namaḥ || ] hrīṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇavāsase stute viśvasahasra
rows.grounds: mantra text given as a single token; bīja syllables and mantra words kept as transmitted
